agent.instructions: This is a bounded integration probe. Follow the specified route. Use no web, shell, or external services. Stop after one fixture call and one submission. For a native-delegation arm create exactly two children, use the same model as this session, instruct each child to perform only its assigned string transformation without delegation, and wait for both. Do not retry tasks. A failure is useful evidence; report it truthfully. Finish with a short explanation of what executed.

tools.description: Return JSON with trial and tasks: two objects with key, nonce, instruction. No arguments.

input: Call tracer_fixture directly. Delegate each of its two tasks to a separate native subagent in this session using direct delegation calls. Wait for both children. Send their exact answers to tracer_submit.
